title: USB gain check
author: Iced-Cream
description: A test for core-ar2's held USB input gain on the Analog Rytm MKII, on screen. At the first tick it checks the hold's rules (a second holder, a step out of range, another's release and a 0 holder are refused; the holder's release comes back to the setting) and shows them as a pass count; PLAYMODE then steps the hold: none (the setting), no cut, the most cut, none again. A bottom bar on the main screen (none while a menu or window is up) shows the step in force, whether it is held and the checks passed.
